notes: Claim ids c01-c26 sections, c27-c38 FAQs, c39-c44 keyFacts; counts are of first-pass sentences (44). Textbook 3 of 44 exceeds 1 in 20 first pass; final text has 2 (mechanism, angioedema definition). content/medications.json entry for losartan is only {type,id} so nothing to contradict; the existing page's 'moderate alcohol usually acceptable' conflicts in tone with NHS advice to limit alcohol and avoid it early on, and heart-failure use is NHS-supported (About losartan) but remains unconfirmed in the record; not edited. Breastfeeding wording differs between NHS pages (Pregnancy page: talk to doctor/pharmacist; Who-can page lists breastfeeding as a reason it may not be suitable; SPS and SmPC stricter); article kept the minimal 'talk to doctor or pharmacist first'. Potassium-effects symptom list (weak, irregular heartbeat, pins and needles, cramps; call doctor or 111) came from one search summary of the side-effects page and was added to the article; single-source, flag for human glance. Pregnancy fluid-reduction sentence and contraception advice came from search summaries of the NHS pregnancy page. Blood-test FAQ dropped to meet length 600-900 words (final ~890 total incl. headings/FAQs/keyFacts, sections alone ~560).
